scope: Independent proposal admission and bounded concurrent design/retrospective/ontology generation while ordinary commands remain responsive

limitations: Capacity applies to each Web application instance, shared across its workspace views; it is not a global quota across independent service processes.
Ordinary task execution retains its separate queue and existing capacity rules.
No external model was invoked; tests use disposable data and offline or synthetic generation.
No release package was built or deployed.
